assets.prompt: Create an original production character asset for Cara, a cheerful roughly 12-year-old Irish teaching assistant who listens and draws diagrams on a whiteboard. Asset 1: ONE full-body neutral puppet master, front facing with a tiny friendly three-quarter suggestion but essentially symmetric and riggable. Young girl with a clear childlike silhouette, round friendly face, dot eyes, small simple smile, three tiny freckles each cheek, simple medium-length wavy hair gathered into one short side ponytail. Fully clothed: loose simple overalls over a long-sleeved shirt and plain trainers. Warm, attentive, clever, happy, an enthusiastic little artist. Match a refined hand-drawn whiteboard product UI: ONLY clean dark blue ink (#2455A6) contour line art with round caps, a very slight hand-drawn wobble, sparse details, no hatching, no shading, no gradients, no 3D, no busy clothing seams, no realistic anatomy. Opaque warm ivory interiors for face, hair and clothing inside the contours; outside the character genuinely TRANSPARENT. Do not draw any checkerboard pattern. Minimal 2D cut-paper puppet geometry: head is a simple detachable oval with hair silhouette; torso a simple rounded shape; arms and legs clearly distinct, hands simple mitten forms, round readable elbow/wrist joints. Both arms slightly away from the torso with generous transparent gaps; feet apart. Right hand holds a single short blue whiteboard marker, angled gently down. Keep all limbs fully visible, no limb crossings or foreshortening. Same line weight throughout. Large character centered with 10 percent clear margin on all sides, entire body visible. Recognizable and readable at 120 pixels tall. No background, no whiteboard, no shadows, no scene, no text, no captions, no labels, no watermark. The look should be charming and original, editorial line drawing rather than a generic corporate mascot or anime character.

Use the supplied Cara master as an identity and style reference. Create ONE character expression/gesture sheet showing exactly SIX small versions of the SAME girl in a spacious evenly aligned 3-column by 2-row layout. Keep identical face, short side ponytail, freckles, blue ink contour, ivory clothing, overalls and proportions. Full body in every cell, identical character scale, same foot baseline within each row, entire figure visible. Top row: attentive listening with a small warm closed-mouth smile and arms at rest; speaking with a small open smile and one open hand; thinking with eyes looking slightly up and one hand lightly at chin. Bottom row: explaining while pointing one arm to the right; drawing with marker held toward the right, turned only slightly; delighted with closed smiling eyes and hands raised to chest height. This is a practical animation pose library, all poses simple and restrained rather than exaggerated. Simplify linework further: flat blue contours with consistent round line weight, plain ivory opaque interiors, minimal face marks, no tonal rendering, no textures, absolutely no glows, no halos, no shadows. No whiteboard, no props beyond one short blue marker where relevant. Outside each separate character is genuinely transparent, not a checkerboard drawing. Generous empty gutters between cells and margins all around. No panels, no grid lines, no numbers, no labels, no text, no background scene. Preserve youthful fully clothed age-appropriate character identity.

Use the supplied Cara master as identity/style reference. Create ONE clean 2D cutout-puppet PARTS ATLAS for that exact cheerful young girl. This is an assembly kit, NOT an assembled character and NOT a scene. Separate every piece with generous transparent space so each can be selected and rotated independently. All body parts drawn at the same scale and compatible straight-on orientation; clear closed contour shapes with rounded overlap tabs at hidden joints. Arrange neatly in rows: first row one detached head with ponytail/hair silhouette and a blank ivory face (NO eyes eyebrows nose or mouth), then one torso with overalls over shirt ending at waist; second row left upper sleeve, right upper sleeve, left forearm, right forearm, all detached and with rounded ends; third row one open mitten hand, one hand holding the short blue whiteboard marker, left trouser leg with trainer attached, right trouser leg with trainer attached; bottom row a matched pair of dot eyes, matched closed smiling eyes, matched small eyebrows, and FOUR tiny standalone mouth shapes (closed smile, small open speaking oval, wider speaking smile, delighted smile). These small facial pieces should be blue ink only and have no face-shaped background. Keep Cara's exact silhouette and clothing designs as reference, but reduce to the minimum crisp blue contour strokes. Opaque flat ivory interiors in head/body/limb pieces, genuine transparent exterior. A flat puppet asset, no shading gradients textures glows halos shadows scene border text labels arrows or watermark. Do not draw an assembled full figure anywhere. No duplicated heads. All components fully visible within frame. This asset will be rigged with rotation at shoulders/elbows/hips and replacement mouths.
